script.text: After his surprise Pendulum Summon against The Sledgehammer, Yuya was more popular than ever!
Uh… who are you?
Me? Merely one of your biggest fans! To be precise, the name's Sylvio. It's an honor!
Oh… hi…
I caught your duel against The Sledgehammer on TV. You were très magnifique!
Your new Pendulum Summoning technique took my breath away. And those cards you used… What do you call them, Yuya?
You mean my Pendulum Cards?
Precisely! Only a duelist of the highest caliber could possibly possess such rare cards!
There's no need to pump up his ego. It's already about to burst as it is.
If you're planning to demonstrate your Pendulum technique, then I have access to a most ideal venue… the Leo Institute!
I thought that was for Leo students only!
I've already reserved the space. I happen to be one of the school's top students.
After arriving at the Leo Institute:
Welcome to the Leo Institute of Dueling! The Institute is managed by the Leo Corporation. They've spared no expense to turn our school into one of the world's top dueling institutions!
I've heard that You Show's an okay school.
Thanks for the compliment! I guess your school's better at everything!
I've gotta admit, this place has a lot of things our school can't offer.
You can learn Xyz Summoning, Synchro Summoning … Whoah! They even teach Fusion Summoning!
I'm curious about the cards you use to Pendulum Summon. You wouldn't mind letting me have a look, would you?
Show my cards? Well… okay… Here they–
Even before Yuya finished speaking, Sylvio snatched Yuya's Pendulum Cards!
So I can Pendulum Summon with these cards? I'm adding them to my rare card collection!
Huh!?
That's not amusing, Sylvio!
I wasn't being funny! Your cards are so unique that I simply can't resist them!
I have something for you. I'm offering these super common cards in exchange for your Pendulum Cards. They're worthless – like you!
No card's worthless!
Alright, it's showtime!
